workspace.title: Root generated artifacts are absent
workspace.test: The repository should not keep stale root build output, Turbo cache, Yarn install cache, or runtime Docker volume contents as working tree artifacts after the monorepo migration.

steps.instruction: Inspect root generated paths after cleanup.
steps.expected: Root dist, .turbo, .yarn/install-state.gz, .yarn/unplugged, and non-.gitkeep docker/volume files are absent from the working tree.

workspace.passCriteria: Only required placeholders remain under docker/volume and no generated root artifact directories remain.

workspace.title: Legacy root src is absent
workspace.test: The old root src tree should be gone because all source now lives under apps/* and packages/ndx.

steps.expected: src does not exist at repository root.

workspace.passCriteria: No legacy root source tree remains and workspace source roots exist.

tracked-tests.title: Legacy tests directory is removed
tracked-tests.test: The tracked tests directory still imports ../src and conflicts with the agenttest-only policy, so it should be removed from the monorepo tree.

steps.instruction: Inspect Git-tracked tests paths after cleanup.
steps.expected: git ls-files tests returns no files.
test/20260507 contains the monorepo cleanup suite and previous strict JSON report artifacts.

tracked-tests.passCriteria: Legacy tests are no longer tracked and the test/ agenttest policy path remains.

documentation.title: Cleanup policy is documented
documentation.test: Repository documentation should describe the monorepo cleanup boundaries so stale root src, dist, tests, and runtime volume contents do not reappear.

steps.expected: docs/testing.md states that test/ is the authoritative path and tests/ must not be used.
Documentation records that source lives under apps/* and packages/ndx and root src/dist are not source-owned paths.

documentation.passCriteria: Docs clearly distinguish source, test policy, and generated cleanup boundaries.

verification.title: Workspace builds after cleanup
verification.test: Removing leftovers must not break the Turbo monorepo build.

steps.instruction: Run yarn install --immutable and yarn build.
steps.expected: Both commands exit successfully and Turbo reports successful package builds.

steps.instruction: Run the compiled ndx and ndxserver version commands.

verification.passCriteria: Install, build, and bin smoke checks all pass after cleanup.
